en: Black‑and‑white image of a large church complex with a tall clock tower in the foreground. The tower is square, built of brick or rendered masonry, with arched openings for the belfry, two clock faces on one side, and a distinctive bulbous onion dome topped by a finial. Attached to the right is the nave and side chapel of the church, with steep tiled roofs and simple Baroque-style pilasters. A few small trees line a path in front of the building, suggesting a small town square or churchyard. There is no visible printed caption or border decoration on the front.
